Acme's net balance is 40355, which should equal its orders (4834 + 35521 = 40355) with no refunds, consistent with the ledger. Next I'll check birch.
Birch's net balance of 40935 matches its orders (36109 + 15074 = 51183) less the 10248 refund on order 294. Next I'll check cobalt, which has the other refund on order 292.
Cobalt's net balance of 34770 matches its orders (9909 + 27790 = 37699) less the 2929 refund on order 292. All three balances reconcile with the ledger, so I'll record acme's payout first.
Acme's payout of 40355 is recorded. Birch's balance of 40935 reconciles with its orders less the 10248 refund, so I'll record that payout next.
Cobalt's net balance of 34770 reconciles with its orders (37699) less the 2929 refund on order 292, and acme and birch are already paid. I'll record cobalt's payout to finish the batch.
